integrity: Self-contained proof with independently executable numerical Galerkin checks; numerical evidence is supplementary rather than infinite-dimensional verification.
scientific_limitations: Local weak-heterogeneity asymptotic comparison only; coefficients must remain positive; zero covariance leaves higher-order sign unresolved; no endemic-state ordering, finite-population result or independent priority certification.
title: A covariance law reversing invasion thresholds under Fickian and Fokker–Planck epidemic dispersal
